## Release Notes

## Added

- Added Delivery Log Archive persistence and reprint workflow.
  - Delivery log PDF generation now stores a local JSON archive for each print under `administration/delivery-log-archives`.
  - Added a new Reports tab to list archived delivery logs, with refresh and reprint actions.
  - Reprint opens archived HTML and appends a local-time `Reprinted` marker.

### Changed

- Delivery-log archive metadata display and naming now use local time consistently.

### Validation

- Changelog update in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- Ready for standard NEXT pipeline validation before tagging and release publishing.
